description: Two subsets of the naturals have the same class modulo finite sets exactly when they are eventually equal along the cofinite filter.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finite_quotient_eq_iff (A B : Set ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ) A =
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.finiteIdeal ℕ) B ↔
    A =ᶠ[Filter.cofinite] B
